jobs.title: Vice President of Technology
jobs.description:
Company Description

Matrixport-NY is a technology-driven financial services organization focused on building secure, scalable, and innovative digital asset solutions. The company leverages advanced information technology and data-driven decision-making to support a broad range of institutional and enterprise clients. Matrixport-NY emphasizes rigorous risk management, regulatory awareness, and operational excellence in all technology initiatives. Team members work in a collaborative, high-performance environment that values transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement. The organization offers opportunities to shape modern financial technology infrastructure and contribute to long-term strategic growth.

Role Description

The Vice President of Technology is a full-time, remote leadership role responsible for defining and executing the company’s technology vision and strategy. This role oversees the design, implementation, and maintenance of core platforms, infrastructure, and applications supporting digital asset and financial services operations. Day-to-day responsibilities include leading technology teams, prioritizing and managing projects, aligning IT initiatives with business goals, and establishing best practices for security, reliability, and scalability. The Vice President of Technology collaborates closely with executive leadership, product, operations, and compliance teams to ensure technology roadmaps support regulatory requirements and organizational growth. The role also includes mentoring technology leaders, optimizing vendor and partner relationships, and continuously assessing emerging technologies and industry trends to drive innovation.

Qualifications

Strong Analytical Skills to interpret complex data, assess technical risks, and support informed strategic decision-making.
Extensive experience in Information Technology, including infrastructure, cloud services, cybersecurity, and enterprise systems architecture.
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute IT Strategy that aligns technology investments with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
Proven Project Management experience leading cross-functional initiatives, managing budgets and timelines, and delivering technology solutions at scale.
Expertise in Strategic Planning, including building long-term technology roadmaps, resource planning, and organizational capability development.
Prior leadership experience in technology management, with a track record of building and mentoring diverse, high-performing teams.
Familiarity with financial services or digital asset/fintech environments, including security, compliance, and risk management considerations.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree or relevant certifications are beneficial.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders in a remote setting.

jobs.title: Director - Finance & IT
jobs.description:
If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.

With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses (https://www.idexcorp.com/our-businesses/business-segments/) around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.

Advanced Flow Solutions (AFS) includes the Liquid Controls and Corken branded products that make fluid transfer safe, accurate, and efficient. Liquid Controls primarily provide metering, fluid handling and data ecosystem for truck-based custody transfer of highly valuable fuels as well as product solutions to support other downstream oil & gas custody transfer applications. Corken offers a wide variety of industrial compression and pumping solutions for the process, energy, and transport industries. Applications include Autogas filling stations, bulk plant pumps, tank-car unloading, delivery truck, and transport. AFS is headquartered in Oklahoma City, OK with a sales/service office in Chicago, IL and an employee base of approximately 220+.

Our $115M+ growth‑focused business unit operates across two distinct revenue streams. The position reports to the Group Vice President, Finance Fire Safety Diversified Products and provides operational finance support to the AFS President and senior leadership team.

Duties/Responsibilities

Direct Finance & IT team and assist business unit President and senior leadership teams in the development of strategic plans and supporting objectives, while proactively managing supporting events to assure attainment of agreed upon performance.
Manage the company’s accounting & IT functions including general ledger, monthly closings and statutory requirements. Direct the financial reporting, financial planning, forecasting, budgeting and product & business line profitability analyses. Indirect management of Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable (includes facilitation of credit process when holding shipments).
Responsible for the reporting, analysis and review of the AFS Consolidated Financials to Corporate Finance and AFS Leadership. AFS Consolidated includes AFS Core (OKC), Energy Asia and SAMPI. Financials to include monthly, quarterly and year-end actual, forecasted and Annual Operating Plan results.
Ensure effective cost accounting, inventory accounting and project costing / tracking processes across the business including control of physical inventories.
Instill financial discipline and rigor into investment analyses and justification, capital appropriation and capital budgeting processes.
Ensure BU’s compliance with IDEX internal policies and procedures to include, but not limited to, Finance Policies, IT policies, FP&A practices and changes, Controllership and other Accounting Policies, Sarbanes-Oxley compliance, Tax, Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and other legally mandated external financial reporting requirements that may be requested from IDEX corporate Finance and Accounting staff.
Manage the Interface with both internal and external auditors as well as provide the primary source of contact for all Corporate requirements of the aforementioned Policies and Regulations, including Trace Compliance and Anti-Corruption Policy
Deployment and application of IDEX Operating Model core processes based on needs of the business to assist in achieving defined organizational, financial, and business goals.
Build and develop a high performing and scalable team including talent pipeline and succession planning
Direct preparation of detailed financial analyses and management reporting results for presentation to the business unit President and senior leadership team (AFS), Segment and IDEX Senior Management.
Coordinate and administer an effective financial plan for the control of the company’s operations by implementing and effectuating an adequate control environment.
Drive, support and utilize the company’s OPEX process improvement initiatives including 8020.
ISO Role – Information Security Officer for AFS, reviews and approves certain IT changes regularly, reviews Cybersecurity risks with IT team monthly, quarterly review of IT Risk Assessment
Lead, direct and ensure the accuracy of forecasting and AOP Process including monthly, quarterly and ad hoc forecasting processes.

Education/Experience

Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance required.
10+ years of relevant work experience in a similar-sized operation, including heavy management experience in financial and manufacturing accounting. Cost accounting expertise is required.
Experience in a process focused organization (80/20, Value Streams, Lean) and experience working with JDE and OneStream is highly desirable.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
Must have a proven track record, demonstrated by a progressive level of growth in responsibility.

Required Skills & Abilities

Deep understanding of accounting principles, practices, procedures, and internal controls across manual and automated systems; exercises sound independent judgment.
Strong analytical and forecasting skills with the ability to translate complex information into clear insights that support business growth.
Demonstrated leadership and supervisory capabilities, fostering teamwork, inclusivity, and high performance.
Excellent organizational skills and project management expertise, with strong oral and written communication abilities, including active listening.
Solid commercial and operational acumen with knowledge of markets, customers, competitors, and key manufacturing drivers.
High energy, hands on, results oriented leader who excels in cross functional environments.
Strategic thinker and problem solver capable of balancing detailed analysis with a broad business perspective.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This role oversees three direct reports and nine indirect reports.

Travel

Up to 10% domestic travel may be required.

Are you ready to join a different kind of company where our people, our culture, and our commitments are centered around providing trusted solutions that improve lives around the world?

Total Rewards

The compensation range for this position is $158,600.00 - $237,800.00, depending on experience. This position may be eligible for performance based bonus plan.

Benefits Package

Our comprehensive U.S. benefit offerings include: Health benefits, 401(k) retirement savings program with company match, PTO, and more. More information on our benefits and rewards can be found on our career page: https://www.idexcorp.com/careers/our-benefits-and-rewards/

jobs.title: ATU Director
jobs.description:
Overview

Microsoft is on a mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Within Microsoft Federal, the Health & Science Mission (HSM) organization partners with some of the nation's most important scientific, research, healthcare, and mission-focused agencies to accelerate innovation through cloud computing, AI, security, data, and productivity solutions.

We are seeking a Senior Director, Health & Science Mission to lead a high-performing sales organization focused on driving customer success, business growth, and digital transformation across a portfolio of strategic Federal Civilian customers. This leader will be responsible for developing and executing business strategy, building senior customer relationships, leading a team of sales professionals, and driving adoption of Microsoft's AI and cloud platform across the Federal landscape. The role serves as a key member of the Federal Civilian Area Team Unit (ATU) Leadership Team and partners closely with senior leaders across Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, Marketing, Partners, and Operations.

Responsibilities

Business Leadership

Lead a portfolio of strategic Federal Civilian accounts to achieve revenue, consumption, market share, and customer success goals.
Develop and execute business plans aligned to organizational priorities and growth objectives.
Drive strategic opportunities and accelerate execution across Azure, AI, Security, Business Applications, Data, and Modern Work solutions.
Own forecasting, pipeline health, territory planning, and business rhythm excellence.

Customer Engagement

Build trusted relationships with customer executives, mission leaders, and technology decision makers.
Establish executive sponsorship strategies that strengthen customer partnerships and accelerate transformation outcomes.
Lead customer planning, executive engagement, and strategic account reviews.
Serve as a senior representative of Microsoft in engagements with customer, industry, and government leaders.

AI and Cloud Transformation

Accelerate customer adoption of Microsoft AI, Copilot, Cloud, Data, and Security solutions.
Partner with technical, customer success, and engineering organizations to deliver measurable customer outcomes.
Drive transformational business initiatives that help customers modernize operations and achieve mission objectives.

People Leadership

Lead, coach, and develop a diverse and inclusive team.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer obsession, and growth mindset.
Build leadership pipelines and succession plans while supporting talent development across the organization.
Attract, retain, and develop top talent.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Partner effectively across Microsoft sales, customer success, specialist, engineering, operations, and partner organizations.
Influence decisions and drive execution in highly matrixed environments.
Lead strategic initiatives and organizational priorities that support long-term business growth.

Operational Excellence

Use data and insights to drive business decisions and improve organizational performance.
Ensure disciplined execution of sales processes, forecasting, opportunity management, and customer planning.
Drive continuous improvement in business management practices and operational rigor.

Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree AND 10+ years experience working in an industry (e.g., financial services, retail, manufacturing, healthcare, energy, government, education, technology) and/or driving digital transformation OR Master's Degree AND 9+ years experience working in an industry (e.g., financial services, retail, manufacturing, healthcare, energy, government, education, technology) and/or driving digital transformation OR 13+ years experience in working in an industry (e.g., financial services, retail, manufacturing, healthcare, energy, government, education, technology) and/or driving digital transformation OR equivalent experience.
8+ years experience making recommendations to and/or collaborating with mid-to-senior level executives.
8+ years experience closing large, complex agreements/deals.

Citizenship & Citizenship Verification

This position requires verification of U.S. citizenship due to citizenship-based legal restrictions. Specifically, this position supports United States federal, state, and/or local United States government agency customer and is subject to certain citizenship-based restrictions where required or permitted by applicable law. To meet this legal requirement, citizenship will be verified via a valid passport, or other approved documents, or verified US government Clearance.

Preferred/Additional Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree AND 13+ years experience working in an industry (e.g., financial services, retail, manufacturing, healthcare, energy, government, education, technology) and/or driving digital transformation OR Master's Degree AND 11+ years experience working in an industry (e.g., financial services, retail, manufacturing, healthcare, energy, government, education, technology) and/or driving digital transformation OR equivalent experience.
1+ year(s) people management experience.
Experience serving Federal Government customers.
Experience leading strategic cloud, AI, security, or digital transformation sales organizations.
Deep understanding of enterprise technology buying cycles and executive engagement.
Experience managing significant revenue accountability and forecasting responsibilities.
Experience developing leaders and building high-performing teams.

Strategic Account Management M5 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $133,000 - $222,700 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $170,300 - $239,800 per year.

Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here:

https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/us-corporate-pay

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
